comment: Required production TLS posture, not a claim that every edge complies. Live probes must distinguish explicit peer rejection from client/network errors. The default-certificate CloudFront edge accepted TLS 1.0/1.1 on 2026-10-16; keep its required minimum at TLS 1.2 so the gate remains failing until the edge is remediated. A controllable viewer policy requires an owned custom domain and suitable certificate.

requirements.comment: These checks require legacy rejection and TLS 1.3 availability; they do not prove TLS 1.3-only operation or hybrid-PQC negotiation. The stricter TLS 1.3-only configuration target remains in post-quantum-policy.json and tls-config-readiness.mjs.

edges.label: backend edge (CloudFront)
edges.note: Fronts the backend API (AURA_BACKEND_ORIGIN). Observed 2026-10-16: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 both negotiated and served HTTP 200. With CloudFrontDefaultCertificate=true, AWS uses the TLSv1 viewer policy regardless of a claimed MinimumProtocolVersion. Do not lower minExpected to match this exposure.
